text:
mike: quick heads-up — after the header canonicalizer roll last night, per-intent telemetry is showing a ~30% drop for some tenants. total request volume unchanged. anyone digging?
tara: saw the same in tracing. the shim canonicalizer keeps the first `x-route` occurrence and drops others in a specific proxy path. reproducer: `curl -H "x-route: tenant=lumo" -H "x-route: intent=onboard" https://api.redwood/v1/chat` 
cheng: that matches. sampling uses route.intent as a shard key, dropping it collapses samples into DEFAULT and skews dashboards.
mike: mitigation proposals: (A) revert shim (bad ops risk), (B) server-side merge multi-valued headers (longer dev), (C) SDK emit an opt-in fallback header, (D) ingestion fallbacks.
tara: fastest pragmatic path is C + D: SDKs emit `x-route-fallback` with a tiny JSON map when multiple `x-route` headers present, ingestion will read fallback if `intent` missing. keep it opt-in behind env var.
elain: obs: we can parse `x-route-fallback` in 48h dev + 1d canary. need a precise schema and rules: prefer `x-route` values if present; fallback only used when keys missing.
cheng: SDK spec: add env var `ROUTE_FALLBACK=1`. When multiple headers present produce: `x-route-fallback: {"tenant":"lumo","intent":"onboard"}`. URL-encode value to avoid proxy stripping. Add compact fallback `x-route-kv: tenant=lumo;intent=onboard` for clients that mangle quotes (mobile).
mike: code hint for python: ```py
if len(route_headers)>1 and os.getenv('ROUTE_FALLBACK')=='1':
  headers['x-route-fallback']=urllib.parse.quote(json.dumps(dict(route_headers)))
```
tara: TS sketch: ```ts
if (routeHeaders.length>1 && process.env.ROUTE_FALLBACK==='1') {
  headers['x-route-fallback'] = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(routeHeaders)))
}
```
obs-bot: Confirmed ingestion schema: flat string values, allowed keys: tenant, intent, priority, feature. Ingest will prefer `x-route` and fall back to `x-route-fallback` or `x-route-kv`.
devop-bot: canary infra: create 5% canary group if requested.
elain: monitoring plan: run a 5% canary where SDK flag is enabled for that cohort. Compare sampled traces where logs include `intent` vs telemetry `intent` over 24h. Raise alert if mismatch > 8%.
cheng: PR checklist for SDKs (py/ts/go): - opt-in env var - unit tests for header generation - e2e test through a mock proxy to ensure header survives - changelog & migration note - include `x-route-kv` fallback for mobile stacks.
mike: owners: cheng (SDKs), elain (ingest), tara (monitoring), i'll take coordination. Tickets: ENG-PL-5320 (coord), INGEST-1155 (ingest), SDK-PRs to reference ENG-PL-5320.
devop-bot: created canary group `route-fallback-5pct` and linked ENG-PL-5320, INGEST-1155. Canary scheduled in 30m.
tara: follow-up: after fallback is validated and parity is restored, schedule shim patch to merge instead of overwrite and then retire fallback after one week stable.
mike: thanks — i'll post an incident note in #incidents and update product ops. please keep replies short and tag if any immediate regression appears. :thumbsup:
